title: El dengue
goal: Have dengue explained to you while you have it
culture: There is no medicine for it. The treatment is fluid and lying down, and the dangerous part is the day the fever drops and you feel better. Every instruction here is one to repeat back, because none of it comes on a piece of paper.

beats.es: Es dengue. Tiene que tomar mucho suero.
beats.good: Suero is rehydration salts, sold in every pulpería. There is no medicine for this and the fluid IS the treatment.

beats.es: Y no se levante. Reposo, joven.
beats.en: I’m not to get up at all?
beats.good: No se levante from him, no me levanto from you. He means it: people get up on day four and end up straight back in here.

beats.es: Si empeora, se viene de una vez.
beats.good: Ask, because the dangerous part of dengue is the day the fever drops and you feel better. He will tell you the signs and you should write them down.

beats.es: Una semana, más o menos, y va a andar bien.
beats.good: A week flat on your back, and everybody you tell afterwards will say they had it worse. They probably did.
